comparison: Candidate shards 2-8 full pytest short-summary node IDs compared against union of baseline shards 1-8
method: Extract complete FAILED and ERROR node IDs through pytest detail delimiter ` - ` (including parameter IDs with spaces); identify SUBFAILED subtest IDs as the full test node ID plus exact SUBFAILED parameter, ignoring progress percentages and deduplicating duplicate progress/short-summary renderings. Compare against union of baseline shards 1-8. Pytest failed totals reconcile as FAILED node IDs + unique SUBFAILED IDs; missing errors field in shard3 summary is treated as zero.
